text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $79k with minimal movement, while Ethereum is flat, suggesting cautious consolidation among the two majors despite a sharp rise in market sentiment over the past week. The Fear & Greed index at 74 (Greed) with a +33 jump signals a rapid shift toward optimism, though Bitcoin's dominance climbing to 59.1% indicates money is flowing preferentially to BTC rather than spreading into alts. Moderate 24h volume of $104B reflects the sentiment lift without aggressive breakout buying, suggesting the market is positioned optimistically but testing conviction before committing to larger moves.
